samples.text: I reviewed the notes this morning and found three details that need a little more attention. None of them is urgent, but I would like us to settle them before Friday.

Before we decide, consider three questions. First, does the voice remain recognisable when the sentence becomes technical? Second, can it move between a short answer and a longer explanation without repeating the same rhythm? Third, what happens when the text includes parentheses, dates, and a list? The answer may differ by checkpoint. A lower validation loss can help us find candidates, but it cannot tell us whether a listener will find the voice natural after two minutes. That is why the final review uses the same text, hidden labels, and a separate reveal mapping.
